import numpy as np, pandas as pd, math, json, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.model_selection import LeaveOneOut, cross_val_score

# ================= Scales =================
EISENBERG=dict(A=0.62,R=-2.53,N=-0.78,D=-0.90,C=0.29,Q=-0.85,E=-0.74,G=0.48,H=-0.40,I=1.38,L=1.06,
               K=-1.50,M=0.64,F=1.19,P=0.12,S=-0.18,T=-0.05,W=0.81,Y=0.26,V=1.08)
KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,M=1.9,
        F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
PACE=dict(A=0.0,L=0.21,R=0.21,M=0.24,K=0.26,Q=0.39,E=0.40,I=0.41,W=0.49,S=0.50,Y=0.53,F=0.54,
          H=0.61,V=0.61,N=0.65,T=0.66,C=0.68,D=0.69,G=1.00,P=3.16)   # kcal/mol, higher = worse helix
BOMAN=dict(L=-4.92,I=-4.92,V=-4.04,P=-4.92,F=-2.98,M=-2.35,W=-2.33,A=-1.81,C=-1.28,G=-0.94,Y=0.14,
           T=2.57,S=3.40,H=4.66,Q=5.54,K=5.55,N=6.64,E=6.81,D=8.72,R=14.92)
PKA=dict(D=4.05,E=4.45,H=5.98,C=9.0,Y=10.0,K=10.0,R=12.0)

def net_charge(seq,pH=7.0,amidated=False):
    q=1/(1+10**(pH-9.0))
    if not amidated: q-=1/(1+10**(3.55-pH))
    for aa in seq:
        if aa in 'KRH': q+=1/(1+10**(pH-PKA[aa]))
        elif aa in 'DECY': q-=1/(1+10**(PKA[aa]-pH))
    return q
def muH(seq,angle=100.0,window=11):
    w=min(window,len(seq)); best=0.0
    for i in range(len(seq)-w+1):
        sub=seq[i:i+w]
        sx=sum(EISENBERG.get(a,0)*math.cos(math.radians(angle*j)) for j,a in enumerate(sub))
        sy=sum(EISENBERG.get(a,0)*math.sin(math.radians(angle*j)) for j,a in enumerate(sub))
        best=max(best,math.hypot(sx,sy)/w)
    return best
def props(name,seq,cls,amidated=False,note=""):
    seq=seq.upper(); n=len(seq)
    return dict(peptide=name,seq=seq,cls=cls,amidated=amidated,length=n,
        net_charge=round(net_charge(seq,amidated=amidated),2),
        frac_cationic=round(sum(seq.count(a) for a in "KR")/n,3),
        muH=round(muH(seq),3), meanH=round(np.mean([EISENBERG.get(a,0) for a in seq]),3),
        gravy=round(np.mean([KD.get(a,0) for a in seq]),3),
        helix_penalty=round(np.mean([PACE.get(a,1.0) for a in seq]),3),
        frac_GP=round(sum(seq.count(a) for a in "GP")/n,3),
        boman=round(np.mean([BOMAN.get(a,0) for a in seq]),2),
        aromatic=round(sum(seq.count(a) for a in "FWY")/n,3),
        max_extended_len_A=round(3.4*n,1), note=note)

# ================= In-silico processing of the NLP-29 precursor =================
NLP29="MISTSSILVLVVLLACFMAASAQWGYGGYGRGYGGYGGYGRGMYGGYGRGMYGGYGRGMYGGYGRGMYGGWGK"
NLP31="MISTSSLLILVVLLACFMAASAQWGYGGMPYGGYGGMGGYGMGGYGMGYRRRMWGSPYGGYGGYGGYGGWGK"
sigend=22                      # UniProt signal peptide 1-22
pro=NLP29[sigend:]             # residues 23-73
# rule: cleave C-terminal to K/R (mono- or dibasic), the preceding Gly is the amide donor (G-K/R motif)
import re
sites=[m.start()+sigend+1 for m in re.finditer(r'[KR]', NLP29[sigend:])]   # 1-based positions of K/R
print("Basic residues (1-based) in pro-region:", sites)
pred=[]; start=sigend+1
for pos in sites:
    frag=NLP29[start-1:pos-1]                      # up to but excluding the basic residue
    if frag.endswith("G"):
        pred.append((start,pos-2,frag[:-1],"amidated (G donor at %d, cleaved after %s%d)"%(pos-1,NLP29[pos-1],pos)))
    else:
        pred.append((start,pos-1,frag,"non-amidated"))
    start=pos+1
print("\nPredicted mature peptides from cleavage+amidation rules:")
for s,e,f,n in pred: print(f"  {s:3d}-{e:3d}  {f:<10s} {n}")
uniprot_annot=["QWGYGGY","GYGGYGGY","GMYGGY","GMYGGY","GMYGGY","GMYGGW"]
print("\nUniProt-annotated mature peptides:", uniprot_annot)
print("Prediction matches UniProt annotation:", [p[2] for p in pred]==uniprot_annot)

# ================= Build comparison table =================
rows=[props(f"NLP-29 {s}-{e} {f}-NH2",f,"NLP-29 mature peptide",amidated=True) for s,e,f,n in pred]
rows.append(props("NLP-29 pro-region 23-73",pro,"NLP-29 precursor",note="unprocessed secreted precursor"))
rows.append(props("NLP-31 pro-region 23-72",NLP31[22:],"NLP-31 precursor",note="paralogue with published in vitro antifungal assay"))
lytic={"Magainin-2":"GIGKFLHSAKKFGKAFVGEIMNS","Melittin":"GIGAVLKVLTTGLPALISWIKRKRQQ",
 "Cecropin A":"KWKLFKKIEKVGQNIRDGIIKAGPAVAVVGQATQIAK","LL-37":"LLGDFFRKSKEKIGKEFKRIVQRIKDFLRNLVPRTES",
 "PGLa":"GMASKAGAIAGKIAKVALKAL","Protegrin-1":"RGGRLCYCRRRFCVCVGR","Indolicidin":"ILPWKWPWWPWRR",
 "Temporin A":"FLPLIGRVLSGIL","HNP-1":"ACYCRIPACIAGERRYGTCIYQGRLWAFCC",
 "hBD-2":"GIGDPVTCLKSGAICHPVFCPRRYKQIGTCGLPGTKCCKKP","Aurein 1.2":"GLFDIIKKIAESF",
 "Pleurocidin":"GWGSFFKKAAHVGKHVGKAALTHYL"}
nonlytic={"Buforin II":"TRSSRAGLQFPVGRVHRLLRK","Bac7(1-16)":"RRIRPRPPRLPRPRPRPLPFPRP",
 "Apidaecin Ib":"GNNRPVYIPQPRPPHPRI","Drosocin":"GKPRPYSPRPTSHPRPIRV"}
neuro={"FMRF-NH2":"FMRF","FLP-1 SADPNFLRF":"SADPNFLRF","FLP-13 AMRNALVRF":"AMRNALVRF",
 "FLP-18 DFDGAMPGVLRF":"DFDGAMPGVLRF","NLP-12 DYRPLQF":"DYRPLQF","Met-enkephalin YGGFM":"YGGFM",
 "Leu-enkephalin YGGFL":"YGGFL","Substance P":"RPKPQQFFGLM","Oxytocin":"CYIQNCPLG","GnRH":"QHWSYGLRPG",
 "alpha-MSH":"SYSMEHFRWGKPV","Neuromedin U-8":"YFLFRPRN",
 "NPY":"YPSKPDNPGEDAPAEDMARYYSALRHYINLITRQRY","Galanin(1-16)":"GWTLNSAGYLLGPHAV"}
for k,v in lytic.items(): rows.append(props(k,v,"membrane-lytic AMP"))
for k,v in nonlytic.items(): rows.append(props(k,v,"non-lytic AMP"))
for k,v in neuro.items(): rows.append(props(k,v,"receptor-ligand neuropeptide",amidated=True))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
os.makedirs("provenance",exist_ok=True); df.to_csv("provenance/nlp29_peptide_physicochemistry.csv",index=False)
pd.set_option("display.width",260); pd.set_option("display.max_columns",30)
print("\n=== Physicochemistry table ===")
print(df[["peptide","cls","length","net_charge","frac_cationic","muH","gravy","helix_penalty","frac_GP","boman","aromatic"]].to_string(index=False))

# ================= Statistics =================
lyt=df[df.cls=="membrane-lytic AMP"]; neu=df[df.cls=="receptor-ligand neuropeptide"]; n29=df[df.cls=="NLP-29 mature peptide"]
print("\n=== Benchmark class comparison (lytic n=%d vs neuropeptide n=%d), Mann-Whitney ==="%(len(lyt),len(neu)))
for v in ["length","net_charge","frac_cationic","muH","helix_penalty","frac_GP"]:
    u,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(lyt[v],neu[v],alternative="two-sided")
    rb=2*u/(len(lyt)*len(neu))-1
    print(f"{v:14s} lytic med={lyt[v].median():7.3f} [{lyt[v].min():.2f},{lyt[v].max():.2f}] | "
          f"neuro med={neu[v].median():7.3f} [{neu[v].min():.2f},{neu[v].max():.2f}] | U={u:5.1f} p={p:.4f} rank-biserial={rb:+.2f}")

print("\n=== NLP-29 mature peptides vs the membrane-lytic AMP distribution ===")
uniq=n29.drop_duplicates(subset="seq")
for v in ["length","net_charge","frac_cationic","muH","helix_penalty"]:
    mu,sd=lyt[v].mean(),lyt[v].std(ddof=1)
    line=[]
    for _,r in uniq.iterrows():
        line.append(f"{r.seq}: {r[v]:.2f} (z={(r[v]-mu)/sd:+.2f})")
    print(f"  {v:14s} lytic mean={mu:.2f}+/-{sd:.2f} ::  "+" | ".join(line))

feats=["length","net_charge","muH","frac_cationic","helix_penalty"]
Xtr=pd.concat([lyt,neu])[feats].values; ytr=np.array([1]*len(lyt)+[0]*len(neu))
sc=StandardScaler().fit(Xtr)
loo=cross_val_score(LogisticRegression(C=1.0,max_iter=5000),sc.transform(Xtr),ytr,cv=LeaveOneOut()).mean()
clf=LogisticRegression(C=1.0,max_iter=5000).fit(sc.transform(Xtr),ytr)
print(f"\nLogistic classifier (lytic vs neuropeptide), LOO-CV accuracy = {loo:.2f} (n={len(ytr)}, majority baseline = {max(ytr.mean(),1-ytr.mean()):.2f})")
print("standardised coefficients:",dict(zip(feats,np.round(clf.coef_[0],2))))
df["P_membrane_lytic"]=clf.predict_proba(sc.transform(df[feats].values))[:,1]
print("\nP(membrane-lytic) by class:")
for c in ["NLP-29 mature peptide","NLP-29 precursor","NLP-31 precursor","receptor-ligand neuropeptide","non-lytic AMP","membrane-lytic AMP"]:
    s=df[df.cls==c]
    print(f"  {c:30s} median={s.P_membrane_lytic.median():.3f}  range=[{s.P_membrane_lytic.min():.3f},{s.P_membrane_lytic.max():.3f}]")
print("\nper-peptide NLP-29/31:")
for _,r in df[df.cls.str.startswith("NLP")].iterrows(): print(f"  {r.peptide:34s} P={r.P_membrane_lytic:.3f}")
df.to_csv("provenance/nlp29_peptide_physicochemistry.csv",index=False)

# ================= Figure =================
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16.5,5.2))
style={"membrane-lytic AMP":("#C0392B","o",70),"non-lytic AMP":("#E67E22","^",70),
       "receptor-ligand neuropeptide":("#2471A3","s",70),"NLP-29 mature peptide":("#148F77","*",320),
       "NLP-29 precursor":("#6C3483","D",110),"NLP-31 precursor":("#B7950B","D",110)}
ax=axes[0]
for c,(col,mk,sz) in style.items():
    s=df[df.cls==c]; ax.scatter(s.muH,s.net_charge,c=col,marker=mk,s=sz,label=c,edgecolors="k",linewidths=0.4,zorder=3)
ax.axhspan(2,7,color="#C0392B",alpha=0.07,zorder=0)
ax.set_xlabel("Eisenberg hydrophobic moment $\\mu_H$ (alpha-helix, 100 deg)")
ax.set_ylabel("Net charge at pH 7.0")
ax.set_title("Charge vs amphipathicity")
ax.legend(fontsize=7.5,loc="upper left"); ax.grid(alpha=0.25)
ax=axes[1]
for c,(col,mk,sz) in style.items():
    s=df[df.cls==c]; ax.scatter(s.length,s.net_charge,c=col,marker=mk,s=sz,edgecolors="k",linewidths=0.4,zorder=3)
ax.axvline(22,ls="--",c="grey"); ax.text(22.6,6.4,"22 aa: minimum helix\nto span a bilayer",fontsize=7.5,color="grey")
ax.set_xlabel("Peptide length (residues)"); ax.set_ylabel("Net charge at pH 7.0")
ax.set_title("Length vs charge"); ax.grid(alpha=0.25)
ax=axes[2]
order=["membrane-lytic AMP","non-lytic AMP","receptor-ligand neuropeptide","NLP-29 mature peptide"]
vals=[df[df.cls==c].P_membrane_lytic.values for c in order]
bp=ax.boxplot(vals,labels=["lytic\nAMP","non-lytic\nAMP","receptor\nneuropeptide","NLP-29\npeptides"],showfliers=False,widths=0.55)
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.scatter(np.random.default_rng(i).normal(i+1,0.055,len(v)),v,s=34,c=[style[order[i]][0]],edgecolors="k",linewidths=0.4,zorder=3)
for nm,c in [("NLP-29 precursor","#6C3483"),("NLP-31 precursor","#B7950B")]:
    y=df[df.cls==nm].P_membrane_lytic.values[0]; ax.axhline(y,ls=":",c=c,lw=1.6); ax.text(1.4,y+0.015,nm,fontsize=7.5,color=c)
ax.set_ylabel("P(membrane-lytic class), logistic model")
ax.set_title("Classifier output (LOO-CV acc = %.2f)"%loo); ax.grid(alpha=0.25,axis="y")
fig.suptitle("NLP-29 mature amidated peptides sit with receptor-ligand neuropeptides, not with membrane-lytic antimicrobial peptides",fontsize=12.5)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
